testcase.name: Scenario: Stage the same command with different display options on two targets: tmp/oblikovati-ribbon-relocated.RcZVDl/pinned-checkout/features/application/ribbon-customization/ribbon-customization.feature:1290:3
testcase.system-out: Scenario: Stage the same command with different display options on two targets ✔ Given a part is active in the MCAD Software with the full Tools ribbon visible ✔ And ribbon customization shows All Commands and empty Part Tools and Part Manage targets ✔ When the user stages 2D Sketches on Part Tools ✔ And the user checks its Large and Text options ✔ And the user switches the target to Part Manage ✔ And the user stages 2D Sketches on Part Manage ✔ Then the Part Manage row has Large and Text unchecked ✔ And the Part Manage target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user switches the target back to Part Tools ✔ Then 2D Sketches remains staged on Part Tools ✔ And its Large and Text options are checked ✔ And the Part Tools target shows a pending-change marker ✔ When the user clicks Cancel ✔ Then the customization dialog closes ✔ And the Tools ribbon remains visible
